descriptor: The tyrant lizard king: a twelve-metre predator with the strongest bite of any known land animal, and one of the last dinosaurs.

specimen.promptDetail: huge deep-jawed head, tiny two-fingered arms, body held horizontal and balanced over two massive hind legs by a long heavy tail held straight out off the ground, pebbly scaly skin in mottled brown and olive with darker banding along the back

physical.weightNote: Scotty, the heaviest known adult, is estimated at about 8.9 t
physical.fact: Its bite at the back teeth is estimated at 35,000 to 57,000 newtons, the strongest of any land animal known, living or extinct.

source.label: Persons, Currie and Erickson 2019, The Anatomical Record

range.summary: Every Tyrannosaurus rex fossil comes from western North America. In its day that was Laramidia, a long island continent cut off from the east by a shallow inland sea. Finds run from Alberta and Saskatchewan through Montana, the Dakotas and Wyoming to Utah, with about fifty partial skeletons known.

fossil.story: Tyrannosaurus rex was the top predator of Laramidia, a warm coastal plain of rivers and forests beside an inland sea. It shared that world with Triceratops, Edmontosaurus and Ankylosaurus. It lived closer in time to us than to Stegosaurus.

source.label: Natural History Museum, London: Dino Directory

threats.title: An asteroid strike
threats.detail: About 66 million years ago an asteroid roughly 10 km wide hit what is now the Yucatán Peninsula in Mexico, leaving the buried Chicxulub crater, about 180 km across.

threats.title: Years of dark and cold
threats.detail: Dust, soot and sulphur thrown into the sky dimmed the sun. Plants and plankton died back, and food chains collapsed from the bottom up.

threats.title: Too big to hide
threats.detail: Almost no land animal heavier than about 25 kg is known to have survived. Small animals that could shelter and live on seeds, insects or carrion came through, the birds among them.

threats.title: Volcanoes in the background
threats.detail: The Deccan Traps in India were pouring out lava around the same time. Most researchers now see them as a lesser stress beside the impact.

sightings.tip: Real bone is heavy and fragile, so many mounts are partly cast. The real skull is often shown separately, at eye level.

summary.text: Tyrannosaurus is a genus of large theropod dinosaur. The type species Tyrannosaurus rex, often shortened to T. rex or colloquially T-Rex, is one of the best represented theropods. It lived throughout what is now western North America, on what was then an island continent known as Laramidia. Tyrannosaurus had a much wider range than other tyrannosaurids. Fossils are found in a variety of geological formations which have been dated to the late Maastrichtian age of the late Cretaceous period, 69 to 66 million years ago, with isolated specimens possibly indicating an earlier origin in the middle Campanian age. It was one of the last known members of the tyrannosaurids and among the last non-avian dinosaurs to exist before the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event.
